scope: Additional descriptive paired analyses for the already fixed training queue
selection_basis: Required static/video and acquisition/decoding questions; specified before any complete five-fold model-seed series
difference_direction: first named pipeline minus second named pipeline
interval: 95% descriptive pointwise percentile interval from class-stratified paired source-recording bootstrap
multiplicity: These secondary intervals are not simultaneous family-wise evidence and do not replace the frozen primary comparison family
unit: Unique source recording; seed and checkpoint are not independent biological samples
interpretation: Pipeline comparisons, not isolated causal effects of temporal information: architectures, retained frame budgets and preprocessing can differ. Both full-export event and raw-image baselines originate from the same AVI cohort. Legacy event timestamps are not used to claim matched physical duration.
